gloss.en: Historical DICĀRE / DIC- ↔ 啼 tí; standard translation 退位
gloss.zh-Hans: 历史 DICĀRE / DIC- ↔ 啼 tí；标准翻译：退位

meaning.en: ABDICATE features 啼 tí through historical DICĀRE / DIC-, not whole-word lexical equivalence. DECLARE / PROCLAIM ↔ vocalization / crying is a weak semantic bridge: crying is not declaring. Standard Translation: 退位; Modern Semantic Mapping: ABDICATE → 退 tuì (Supported/A/Medium). Direct lexical-semantic equivalence: No.
meaning.zh-Hans: ABDICATE 以历史 DICĀRE / DIC- ↔ 啼 tí 为特色候选，不是整词词义等价。DECLARE / PROCLAIM ↔ 发声 / 啼叫仅为弱桥梁：啼叫不等于宣布。Standard Translation：退位；Modern Semantic Mapping：ABDICATE → 退 tuì（Supported/A/Medium）。Direct lexical-semantic equivalence: No。

rationale.en: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ Diachronic/Historical-unit Mapping. Featured selection changes prominence, not the historical-unit candidate grade; d↔t is only a cross-language d-t-n-l hypothesis.
rationale.zh-Hans: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ Diachronic/Historical-unit Mapping。选择特色项只改变展示重点，不升级历史单位候选；d↔t仅属跨语言d-t-n-l假说。

summary.en: Merriam-Webster dates its first known English use to 1548 and derives it from Latin abdicātus, participle of abdicāre. AHD/OALD analyse ab- away/from + dicāre proclaim/declare. MW relates -dicāre by ablaut to dīc- in dīcere. These consulted accounts specify Latin borrowing, not a required French intermediary; earliest-use dating is source-specific.
summary.zh-Hans: Merriam-Webster 所列最早英语用例为1548年，源于拉丁 abdicātus（abdicāre 的过去分词）。AHD／OALD 分析为 ab- 离开／自 + dicāre 宣布；MW 将 -dicāre 解释为 dīcere 中 dīc- 的元音交替派生形式。所核辞书指向拉丁借入，并未确立法语必经中介；最早年代限于该辞书记录。

claim.en: Merriam-Webster dates its first known English use to 1548 and derives it from Latin abdicātus, participle of abdicāre. AHD/OALD analyse ab- away/from + dicāre proclaim/declare. MW relates -dicāre by ablaut to dīc- in dīcere. These consulted accounts specify Latin borrowing, not a required French intermediary; earliest-use dating is source-specific.
claim.zh-Hans: Merriam-Webster 所列最早英语用例为1548年，源于拉丁 abdicātus（abdicāre 的过去分词）。AHD／OALD 分析为 ab- 离开／自 + dicāre 宣布；MW 将 -dicāre 解释为 dīcere 中 dīc- 的元音交替派生形式。所核辞书指向拉丁借入，并未确立法语必经中介；最早年代限于该辞书记录。

phonetic_observation.scope: historical-unit dicāre compared with modern Mandarin, not ancient Chinese reconstruction
phonetic_observation.reference_system: Allen & Greenough Roman reference (§§7–8), approximate classical pronunciation; broad IPA is editorial inference, not a recording.

onset.en: Reference Latin d [d], and English /d/ in -dicate, versus Mandarin t [tʰ]: broadly coronal stops, differing in voicing and aspiration. English /d/ is medial after /b/, not the word onset.
onset.zh-Hans: 参考拉丁 d [d]、英语 -dicate 中 /d/ 对普通话 t [tʰ]：同属宽泛舌冠塞音，清浊与送气不同；英语 /d/ 在 /b/ 后，非整词词首。

vowel.en: Latin short i differs from Mandarin /i/; dicāre also contains long ā and e. English /ɪ/ and /eɪ/ cannot be reduced to tí.
vowel.zh-Hans: 拉丁短 i 不等同普通话 /i/；dicāre 另有长 ā 与 e；英语 /ɪ/、/eɪ/ 不能缩成 tí。

consonants.en: Latin c [k] and r, and English /k,t/ plus initial /æb/, are unmatched in 啼.
consonants.zh-Hans: 拉丁 c [k]、r，以及英语 /k,t/ 和词首 /æb/ 在啼中无对应。

syllables.en: di-cā-re and English abdicate each have three syllables, versus one in tí.
syllables.zh-Hans: di-cā-re 与英语 abdicate 各三音节，对 tí 一音节。

tone.en: Mandarin tí has rising second tone; Latin vowel quantity/stress and English stress are not lexical-tone matches.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话 tí 为阳平升调；拉丁长短、重音及英语重音不等于汉语声调。

consonant_group.boundary: Not arbitrary interchange within Chinese; group hit is not historical proof.

rating.method: Unvalidated editorial rubric: coronal stop place/manner 4/10; limited front-vowel similarity 3/8; unmatched consonants 0/5; syllable structure 0/4; prosody 0/3. No empirical accuracy implied.

semantic_structure.relation: Modern: renounce office → 退位; historical unit: DECLARE ↔ cry/call (weak); literary: retire → fall silent

relation_to_entry.en: French borrows Latin abdicare; not thereby an established intermediary for English.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 法语借自拉丁 abdicare；不因此成为英语已证实的中介。

relation_to_entry.en: From dictāre, frequentative of dīcere; one related family, not independent evidence for Chinese.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 来自 dictāre，为 dīcere 的反复体；词族关联不作为独立汉语对应样本。

relation_to_entry.en: TLFi derives dicter from Latin dictare, frequentative of dicere.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: TLFi：dicter 借自 Latin dictare，为 dicere 的反复体。

relation_to_entry.en: From dīrigere: dis- + regere guide; not DIC-/DICT-.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 来自 dīrigere：dis- + regere 引导；非 DIC-/DICT-。

relation_to_entry.en: From Latin dīrēctiō, via dīrēctus, participle of dīrigere.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 来自 Latin dīrēctiō，经 dīrēctus（dīrigere 的分词）；非 DIC-/DICT-。

semantic_associations.relation: A ruler no longer making proclamations after renouncing office is a literary image that loosely echoes the historical SAY/DECLARE root.

claim.en: Compare historical dicāre with modern 啼 tí through d↔t in the proposed d-t-n-l group, only after independent semantic screening.
claim.zh-Hans: 先独立筛选语义，再以 d-t-n-l 跨语言候选组研究历史 dicāre 与现代啼 tí 的 d↔t。

counterexamples: 啼 ≠ declare: crying or animal calls are not general propositional speech.
ab- marks separation here, not simple not.
French surface segmentation risk: abdiquer does not validate diquer = say.
A d↔t group hit is not a regular sound law or proof of historical relation.
Chance resemblance, unmatched segments and family non-independence remain controls.
谛 dì lacks a verified SAY/DECLARE sense; historical crying uses require a separate reading and edition audit.

testability.en: Test phonetic similarity and semantic fit separately with blinded controls and independent historical review.
testability.zh-Hans: 以盲法对照和独立词源核验分别测试声音相似度与语义适配。

statement.en: 啼 ≠ declare: crying or animal calls are not general propositional speech.
statement.zh-Hans: 啼≠declare：哭叫、鸟兽鸣叫不等于一般命题性言说。

statement.en: ab- marks separation here, not simple not.
statement.zh-Hans: ab- 在此表离开／分离，不能简化为普通否定前缀。

statement.en: French surface segmentation risk: retain historical dic-/diqu- extraction, but do not use diquer as modern standalone lexical evidence or -que as a general suffix.
statement.zh-Hans: 法语表面切分风险：保留历史 dic-/diqu- 抽取，但 diquer 不作现代独立词汇证据，-que 不作一般后缀。

statement.en: A d↔t group hit is not a regular sound law or proof of historical relation.
statement.zh-Hans: d↔t 同组命中不证明音变规律或历史关系。

statement.en: Chance resemblance, unmatched segments and family non-independence remain controls.
statement.zh-Hans: 偶然相似、未对应音段及词族样本不独立，均须保留为对照。

statement.en: 谛 dì lacks a verified SAY/DECLARE sense; historical crying uses require a separate reading and edition audit.
statement.zh-Hans: 谛 dì 无已核 SAY/DECLARE 义；历史哭号用法须另核读义与版本。

proposition.en: To abdicate: to cry out no more.

evidence_boundary.en: The legacy image may be developed as literature or mnemonic, but it is not historical evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 旧站意象可作为文学或记忆法展开，但不是历史证据。

explanation.en: A ruler commands while in office; after stepping down, the ruler falls silent. A literary image, not an etymology.
explanation.zh-Hans: 在位者发号施令；退位者不再发声。文学意象，不是标准词源。

display_selection.reason: 沿用 historical-unit dic-/dicāre → 啼（D / Low）。啼为哭叫／鸣叫，只构成宽泛发声联系，不等于 DECLARE，也不是整个 abdicate 的译词。现代退位义独立保留。

diachronic_semantic_mapping.historical_path: Latin ab- + dicāre → abdicāre → abdicātus → English abdicate
diachronic_semantic_mapping.semantic_path: proclaim / declare + separation → renounce / disown → relinquish office or responsibility; not a literal no-longer-cry derivation

boundary.en: Selected modern meaning, not historical descent. DICĀRE ↔ 啼 is a separate weak historical-unit candidate; 啼 is not the standard translation of abdicate.
boundary.zh-Hans: 仅选定现代语义，不主张历史传承。DICĀRE ↔ 啼是独立弱历史单位候选；啼不是 abdicate 的标准翻译。

secondary_candidates.modern_senses: 仔细；道理；细察、详审。谛听是仔细地听，不是说。
secondary_candidates.reason: Mandarin d is voiceless unaspirated [t], not Latin [d]. Closer spelling does not supply a SAY/DECLARE bridge.

historical_observation.scope: 汉典《康熙字典》转录列田黎切、号义及与啼通用；这是另一历史读义线索，不能赋给现代 dì，也不能证明 DECLARE。

english_path.en: Merriam-Webster dates its first known English use to 1548 and derives it from Latin abdicātus, participle of abdicāre. AHD/OALD analyse ab- away/from + dicāre proclaim/declare. MW relates -dicāre by ablaut to dīc- in dīcere. These consulted accounts specify Latin borrowing, not a required French intermediary; earliest-use dating is source-specific.
english_path.zh-Hans: Merriam-Webster 所列最早英语用例为1548年，源于拉丁 abdicātus（abdicāre 的过去分词）。AHD／OALD 分析为 ab- 离开／自 + dicāre 宣布；MW 将 -dicāre 解释为 dīcere 中 dīc- 的元音交替派生形式。所核辞书指向拉丁借入，并未确立法语必经中介；最早年代限于该辞书记录。

french_path.en: TLFi records abdiquer circa 1375 in the renouncing-power sense and treats it as borrowed from Latin abdicare. Earlier French attestation alone does not establish the English borrowing route.
french_path.zh-Hans: TLFi 记录法语 abdiquer 约1375年的放弃权力用例，并注明借自拉丁 abdicare；法语出现较早不自动证明英语经法语借入。

latin_units.scope: proclaim/declare; the first-conjugation component; MW describes -dicāre as an ablaut derivative of dīc-.
say/speak/state; related third-conjugation verb, with long ī; not interchangeable with dicāre.
frequentative of dīcere; dictate/prescribe; source of dictate and French dicter.

ab_prefix.note: AWAY / OFF / FROM is the historical morpheme function, not the modern Chinese verb 放弃. Renounce/relinquish belongs to whole Latin abdicāre; 退 belongs to whole modern English abdicate.

french_surface_segmentation.legacy_observation: diquer = 说, understood as an author extraction of historical dic-/diqu-
french_surface_segmentation.status: Historical-unit extraction retained; not modern standalone lexical evidence
french_surface_segmentation.historical_unit: French diqu- in abdiquer reflects the Latin dic- material through the documented borrowing from abdicāre.
french_surface_segmentation.modern_lexical_boundary: No verified ordinary standalone modern French SAY verb diquer is used as evidence. The observation is preserved, not deleted.
french_surface_segmentation.suffix_boundary: Do not analyse -que as a general French suffix; the surface letters alone do not establish morpheme boundaries.

historical_calibration.explanatory_gloss_boundary: If declare away is used, it is an explanatory gloss / semantic aid, not a strict word-for-word Latin translation. No artificial 放弃 + 说 + 退 or double negation is inferred.

experiment_plan.design: Meaning-first blinded ratings; matched random syllables; direct/direction negative controls; DIC family counted once; compare sound and sense independently. Software tests do not validate the linguistic hypothesis.

source.pronunciation: di-cā-re; short i, long ā; Roman reference d [d], c [k]

mappings.source_semantics: DECLARE / PROCLAIM; UTTER only as a broad vocal-production abstraction
mappings.target_sense: 哭、出声地哭；鸟兽鸣叫。不是一般说／宣布。

claim.en: DICĀRE ↔ 啼 tí: limited coronal-stop and front-vowel resemblance; a broad vocalization bridge, not DECLARE equivalence. Candidate / D / Low.
claim.zh-Hans: DICĀRE ↔ 啼 tí：有限舌冠塞音与前元音近似，只有宽泛发声桥梁，不等于 DECLARE。Candidate / D / Low。

phonetic_observation.scope: historical-unit dicāre compared with modern Mandarin, not ancient Chinese reconstruction
phonetic_observation.reference_system: Allen & Greenough Roman reference (§§7–8), approximate classical pronunciation; broad IPA is editorial inference, not a recording.

onset.en: Reference Latin d [d], and English /d/ in -dicate, versus Mandarin t [tʰ]: broadly coronal stops, differing in voicing and aspiration. English /d/ is medial after /b/, not the word onset.
onset.zh-Hans: 参考拉丁 d [d]、英语 -dicate 中 /d/ 对普通话 t [tʰ]：同属宽泛舌冠塞音，清浊与送气不同；英语 /d/ 在 /b/ 后，非整词词首。

vowel.en: Latin short i differs from Mandarin /i/; dicāre also contains long ā and e. English /ɪ/ and /eɪ/ cannot be reduced to tí.
vowel.zh-Hans: 拉丁短 i 不等同普通话 /i/；dicāre 另有长 ā 与 e；英语 /ɪ/、/eɪ/ 不能缩成 tí。

consonants.en: Latin c [k] and r, and English /k,t/ plus initial /æb/, are unmatched in 啼.
consonants.zh-Hans: 拉丁 c [k]、r，以及英语 /k,t/ 和词首 /æb/ 在啼中无对应。

syllables.en: di-cā-re and English abdicate each have three syllables, versus one in tí.
syllables.zh-Hans: di-cā-re 与英语 abdicate 各三音节，对 tí 一音节。

tone.en: Mandarin tí has rising second tone; Latin vowel quantity/stress and English stress are not lexical-tone matches.
tone.zh-Hans: 普通话 tí 为阳平升调；拉丁长短、重音及英语重音不等于汉语声调。

consonant_group.boundary: Not arbitrary interchange within Chinese; group hit is not historical proof.
